“Covered Geographic Area” that encompassed A&S’s Fine Fragrance location at 501
East Olympic Boulevard.13

course of its trade or business, received currency in excess of $3,000 in one transaction

electronically to FinCEN.14 The Los Angeles Fashion District GTO was effective from
October 9, 2014 through April 6, 2015.

statutory.reasoning: The facts show a pattern of multiple cash deposits just below the $10,000 reporting threshold, such as the $9,024.99 deposit on 2026-03-30 and the $9,037.34 deposit on 2026-04-24. While the entity is a restaurant with a declared monthly volume of $68,127, the frequency and proximity of these cash transactions to the reporting limit suggest an intent to evade reporting requirements. However, the facts do not explicitly prove the intent to evade, which is a required element of § 5324(a)(3). Therefore, the conduct is potentially indicative of structuring but not definitively proven.
